evals.prompt: I think my local QCFractal is already up. Please verify it is active using process checks and qcportal connection to localhost:7777, then give me a concise health summary.
evals.expected_output: Checks both qcfractal-server and qcfractal-compute-manager processes, runs qcportal PortalClient connection test to localhost:7777, and returns concise status.

evals.prompt: My existing QCFractal setup in $QCF_BASE_FOLDER is currently down. Start server and compute manager in background with monitorable logs, then re-check process status and qcportal connectivity.
evals.expected_output: Uses existing config under QCF_BASE_FOLDER, starts server and manager detached, includes monitoring commands, and verifies with process plus qcportal checks.

evals.prompt: I have no local QCFractal instance yet. Initialize using qca.py defaults, require QCF_BASE_FOLDER, start services in background, and confirm I can connect via qcportal.
evals.expected_output: Requires QCF_BASE_FOLDER, follows qca.py-style initialization defaults, starts server/manager in background, and validates connectivity with PortalClient.
